title: Revelation
author: John.
audience: Seven churches in Asia and all believers awaiting Christ's victory.
historicalSetting: Revelation unveils Jesus Christ as the risen Lord, Lamb, King, Judge, and Bridegroom who brings God's kingdom to completion.
christFocus: Revelation is centered on Jesus Christ as the slain and risen Lamb, victorious King, righteous Judge, and coming Bridegroom who makes all things new.
outline: Vision of Christ and letters — Revelation 1-3
Christ's victory and final judgment — Revelation 19-20
New heaven, new earth, and coming Lord — Revelation 21-22
